source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Clearly identify the test parameters.
3. Specify the advertised specifications.
4. Compare test results against advertised specifications.
5. Highlight discrepancies with clarity.
6. Conduct multiple tests to confirm failed specifications.
7. Describe test conditions accurately.
8. Present data in an organized and readable format.
9. Provide photographs or video evidence, if possible.
10. Use precise and objective language.
11. Avoid personal opinions or subjective interpretations.
12. Note specific sections of the product manually or otherwise.
13. Include a summary of key findings.
14. Mention test equipment and its calibration status.
15. Timestamp each test and record.
16. Maintain a record of personnel involved in testing.
17. Attach any relevant supplementary information or documents.
18. Ensure testing is conducted under consistent and replicateable conditions.
19. Reference applicable product standards or regulations.
20. Include a conclusion section that summarizes the findings.<|end_of_text|>
